steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: Haha... Ahhhhh!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Get out of here!
Corpses are piling up at her feet. Her fury is blood-curdling.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Horo is getting more powerful. Is it because... the inheritance is resonating with her?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't understand. Isn't that thing on the side of the gangs?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The inheritance is resonating with Mania. It activates the powers of all Maniacs, and in return, Maniacs running wild allows the inheritance to continue its activation.
The crazy scene before you brings on a sudden realization. You now understand why the mystery arms dealer, a calculating creature, would hire gangsters, who have a tendency to betray.
It's impossible that he failed to anticipate the betrayal of these people. Rather, this is exactly what he intended; he tapped into the gangs' greed.
This isn't a bid for the inheritance. This is a trap. He gathered all these people here and used their craziness to feed the inheritance. He's trying to cultivate something...

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: ****... ****... You mad dog from the Legion... Go to hell!
They raise their contamination-infused spears and lunge at Horo, paying little regard to the bodies of their fellows in the front.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hahaha... Got you!

Not even bothering to wipe away the blood, she grasps the spear that has pierced her torso with one hand and wields her ax with the other. The blow blasts the two front rows of enemies away to one side.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: My Legion... As long as I'm still standing...
At the center of the storm, the warrior's body takes on a demon-like quality. Contamination is flowing out of her short stature, and only the battle mark on her arm is burning, glowing a blood-red.
You are no stranger to that feeling. A huge shadow enshrouds Horo, malicious insubstantial hands reaching out from the stone altar to touch her, tempt her, and corrupt her...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If not suppressed by the shackles, the contamination will overpower a Sinner. Horo is turning into a Corruptor.
No... You can't let this happen again... You're not going to stand aside and watch this time...

options: Catch her, and I'll put the shackles on her!

steps.content: ...Before she's consumed by that thing.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Gangsters
steps.content: She can't hold out much longer. Go! Take her down!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Ahhhhh!!!
She swings the ax insanely, facing the fierce attack head-on and not backing away a bit.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop it... Stop it!
Clank!

A massive block flies over from behind, clearing anything that stands in its way, and squarely collides with the stone altar before going limp and sliding down. It's a human body, used as a cannonball.
In that instant, the air curdles up. Fear has produced in the enemies a moment of clarity—they are staring at the space behind you, their bodies shuddering.
In dead silence, footsteps draw near, move past you, and continue ahead.
You recognize the figure. You're familiar with the awe-inspiring aura. Mania forms twisted shapes on her body. It's her...

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: ...It's Zoya! Quick! Quick! Don't let her come over here!
As if being jolted out of a reverie, they now turn their guns on her and mount a hysterical last-ditch attack.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, protect the Chief!

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: She's on her last legs. Take them down!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Bring it on, together.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm sending you down to hell!
